QuestionStmt.S: Calculate the volume of unit cell having atomic radius 141.4 pm forming fcc unit cell.

Solution.S:
For a face-centered cubic (fcc) unit cell, the relation between the edge length (a) and atomic radius (r) is:

$$a = 2\sqrt{2}r$$

Given, r = 141.4 pm.

Let's calculate step by step:

Find the edge length a:
$$a = 2\sqrt{2} \times 141.4 \, \text{pm}$$
$$\sqrt{2} \approx 1.414$$
$$a = 2 \times 1.414 \times 141.4$$
$$a = 2 \times 200.04 = 400.08 \, \text{pm}$$

So, a = 400.08 pm.

Convert a to cm:
$$1 \, \text{pm} = 10^{-12} \, \text{m} = 10^{-10} \, \text{cm}$$
$$a = 400.08 \times 10^{-10} \, \text{cm}$$

Find the volume of the unit cell:
Volume = a^3
$$\text{Volume} = (400.08 \times 10^{-10} \, \text{cm})^3$$
$$= (400.08)^3 \times (10^{-10})^3 \, \text{cm}^3$$
$$= 64,\!064,\!000 \times 10^{-30} \, \text{cm}^3$$
$$= 6.4064 \times 10^7 \times 10^{-30} \, \text{cm}^3$$
$$= 6.4064 \times 10^{-23} \, \text{cm}^3$$

Rounding to two significant digits:
$$6.4 \times 10^{-23} \, \text{cm}^3$$

Correct answer: Option C
